unary_unary_rpc: invoke a unary-unary gRPC call without an explicit channel using the simple stubs API
unary_stream_rpc: invoke a unary-stream gRPC call that returns an iterator of responses without an explicit channel
stream_unary_rpc: invoke a stream-unary gRPC call that accepts a request iterator and returns a single response
stream_stream_rpc: invoke a stream-stream gRPC call that accepts and returns iterators without an explicit channel
ChannelCache_get_channel: get or create a cached gRPC channel with optional credentials and compression settings
